subject: Is it possible to fit Seemingly Unrelated Regressions using brms?

messages.author: bafbff7f5abd72d1
messages.subject: Is it possible to fit Seemingly Unrelated Regressions using brms?
parts:
This is described on page 155 of the Stan manual.

I know that I can use cbind() to specify multiple outcome measures in brms. However, I'm not sure if it's possible to specify that their errors should follow a covariance matrix, rather than being independent?

Thanks!

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Is it possible to fit Seemingly Unrelated Regressions using brms?
parts: When using cbind notation the residual covariance matrix will be estimated as well.

Thanks!
